title: 第022章 登籍内门承荣誉，古阁清音启传承
content_zh:
转眼间，便到了三日后。

    这一天，是清风宗外门弟子转入内门的大典。

    整个清风宗都热闹非凡。

    外门广场上，挤满了前来观礼的弟子。

    所有人的目光，都聚焦在广场中央的青衣少女身上。

    蔡文姬穿着一身崭新的内门弟子服饰，浅青色的衣袍衬得她身姿纤细，眉眼清澈。

    虽然脸色依旧带着淡淡的苍白。

    却难掩一身温润如玉的气质。

    梦奇变成巴掌大小，稳稳地窝在她的发顶，好奇地东张西望。

    时不时调皮地揪一下蔡文姬的头发，惹得她无奈地抿嘴淡淡一笑。

    周管事站在高台上，手持宗门令牌。

    神情肃穆地主持着转入大典。

    “今日，举行外门弟子转入内门大典。”

    “外门弟子蔡小姬，心性端正，功绩卓著。”

    “下山历练期间，肃清七村祸患，治愈数千百姓。”

    “扬我清风宗正道威名，特准其直接转入内门，位列内门弟子榜首！”

    话音落下。

    广场上瞬间爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼声。

    “蔡师妹当之无愧！”

    “恭喜蔡师妹！”

    “清风宗有蔡师妹，是我们的福气！”

    “小仙兽也好可爱啊！”

    欢呼声此起彼伏，久久不息。

    蔡文姬走上高台，对着周管事深深躬身行礼。

    “弟子蔡小姬，定不负宗门所托。潜心修行，护佑宗门，守护苍生。”

    周管事满意地点了点头。

    将一枚刻着“内门”二字的青色令牌，交到了她的手中。

    “好！”

    “这是你的内门弟子令牌。”

    “从今往后，你便是我清风宗内门弟子。享有内门一切资源与待遇。”

    蔡文姬双手接过令牌，再次躬身道谢。

    大典结束后。

    周管事带着蔡文姬，朝着宗门后山走去。

    一路上，不少内门弟子纷纷侧目。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, it was three days later.

    This day is the grand ceremony for the disciples of the outer sect of Qingfeng Sect to transfer to the inner sect.

    The entire Qingfeng Sect was very lively.

    The outer square was crowded with disciples who came to watch the ceremony.

    Everyone's eyes were focused on the girl in green in the center of the square.

    Cai Wenji was wearing a brand new inner sect disciple's clothing. The light blue robe made her slender figure and clear eyebrows.

    Although his face is still slightly pale.

    But he can't hide his gentle and jade-like temperament.

    Meng Qi became the size of a palm and nestled firmly on the top of her hair, looking around curiously.

    From time to time, he would playfully pull Cai Wenji's hair, causing her to purse her lips and smile helplessly.

    Manager Zhou stood on the high platform, holding the sect token.

    He solemnly presided over the transition ceremony.

    "Today, the grand ceremony for the transfer of outer sect disciples into the inner sect will be held."

    "Outer disciple Cai Xiaoji has a good nature and outstanding achievements."

    "During the training period down the mountain, we eliminated the disasters in seven villages and cured thousands of people."

    "In order to promote the reputation of our Qingfeng Sect's righteous path, we specially allow him to transfer directly to the inner sect and rank first among the inner sect's disciples!"

    The words fell.

    Thunderous cheers instantly erupted in the square.

    "Junior Sister Cai is well-deserved!"

    "Congratulations to Junior Sister Cai!"

    "We are lucky to have Junior Sister Cai in Qingfeng Sect!"

    "The little fairy beast is so cute!"

    Cheers came and went for a long time.

    Cai Wenji walked up to the high platform and bowed deeply to Manager Zhou.

    "Disciple Cai Xiaoji will definitely live up to the trust of the sect. Practice with concentration, protect the sect, and protect the common people."

    Manager Zhou nodded with satisfaction.

    He handed a cyan token with the word "Inner Gate" engraved on it into her hand.

    "Okay!"

    "This is your inner disciple token."

    "From now on, you are my disciple of the inner sect of Qingfeng Sect. You will enjoy all the resources and benefits of the inner sect."

    Cai Wenji took the token with both hands and bowed again to thank her.

    After the ceremony.

    Manager Zhou took Cai Wenji towards the back mountain of the sect.

    Along the way, many inner disciples looked sideways.
title_en: Chapter 022: Enrolling in the inner sect inherits the honor, and the ancient pavilion Qingyin starts the inheritance
